matter_background.original: By a Final Decree dated 22nd October 2001 entered in District Court Kaduwela Partition Case No 2525/P land and premises bearing No 12, Perera Mawatha Battaramulla depicted as Lot 1 in Partition Plan No 1005 dated 24th July 2001 made by H Silva Licensed Surveyor containing in extent 40 perches was allotted to Mahesh Gunesekara. He was married to Malani and had two children namely Kapila and Mithila By Deed of Gift No 925 dated 11th March 2006 attested by PK Hilton Notary Public the said Lot 1 in extent 40 perches was gifted to his son Kapila Gunesekera as an absolute and irrevocable gift subject to life interest of the Donor Mahesh Gunesekara Mahesh Gunesekera died on 24th April 2008. Kapila had a daughter named Anusha by his first wife Sandya. Sandya died and from his second wife Champa ,Kapila had three more children namely Prema,Rupa and Seetha. Kapila Gunesekera died intestate on 24th January 2011. Anusha Gunesekara married to Hasitha Perera and died on 15th June 2012 issueless Prema Gunesekara died on 4th September 2015 unmarried and issueless
